ns2:section.sectionText: This section will open to BS: Inf Sys & Info Tech - UIUC on Monday, November 12, 2018 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This section will open to BS: Accountancy - UIUC, BS: Finance - UIUC, BS: Marketing - UIUC, BS: Supply Chain Mgmt - UIUC, BS: Business Process Mgt - UIUC, BS: Business Multi Majors - UIUC, MS: Finance Cost Rec - UIUC, MBA: (PT) Business Admin - UIUC, MS: Technology Management - UIUC and MBA: Bus Administration - UIUC on Monday, November 19, 2018 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This section will open to Industrial & Enterprise Systems Engineering students on Monday, November 26, 2018 at approximately 10:00 a.m. There are currently 10 reserved seats for Gies College of Business international exchange students; any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, January 18, 2019 at approximately 10:00 a.m. Any exchange students outside of Gies College of Business that register will be removed from the course.
